statement: The drag decomposition below is the structure required by Issue #4. It is NOT an approved numerical model and must not be summed mechanically across incompatible outputs. Missing, overlapping and uncalibrated terms are flagged with explicit uncertainty.

target_structure.x: the 12D lifting-surface vector (W01-W10, V01-V02); the fuselage is fixed but not removed from the physics
target_structure.note: All terms must first be reconciled as dimensional forces in N (RCAIDE body axes) before any q_inf*Sref conversion. CD values on different reference areas must never be added directly.

component_ledger.basis: N, integrated over wing strips; normalised by Sref=358.25 m2 on output
component_ledger.availability: computed inside every archived P2 evaluation but not exported as a separate N-force row

component_ledger.basis: CD on Sref; only Main_Wing is looped
component_ledger.double_counting_risk: HIGH with D-LS-1: both are lift-induced/lift-dependent terms; RCAIDE declares additivity but no proof exists

component_ledger.term: wing parasite drag (friction + form + compressibility + Reynolds)
component_ledger.rcaide_source: Common/Drag/parasite_drag_wing.py + compressible turbulent flat plate methods
component_ledger.basis: CD on Sref from per-segment wetted area, MAC, t/c, sweep
component_ledger.double_counting_risk: LOW-MEDIUM: compressibility factor inside parasite may overlap the separate compression term

component_ledger.basis: CD on Sref; forced to 0 when Mach>1
CD on Sref; Re from fuselage length; form factor 2.5
component_ledger.double_counting_risk: MEDIUM: fuselage wetted area is the computed 488.922 m2 (+10.62% vs upstream 442)

component_ledger.basis: CD = CD_wave_volume_frontal * A_max/Sref; uses geometry length and A_max
component_ledger.double_counting_risk: MEDIUM: area-rule approximation, uses fixed fuselage length/max area; overlaps with the lift term only if the drag rise is attributed twice

component_ledger.basis: multiplies fuselage lift; affects induced drag through the lift solution
component_ledger.double_counting_risk: N/A: it is a lift term, not a drag term

component_ledger.note: This is exactly the term GATE-CORRECTION requires; the archived build-up does not expose it as a separable quantity.

component_ledger.basis: multiplies the whole sum, not a component
component_ledger.double_counting_risk: LOW but hides a 2% global uplift with no uncertainty statement

double_counting_assessment.headline: RCAIDE's total_drag docstring claims 'All drag components are additive with no overlap' (total_drag.py:54-55) and normalises every term to the same reference area. That claim is an implementation statement, not independent validation for this configuration.

highest_risk_pairs.reason: Trefftz induced drag and JAXA supersonic lift wave drag both scale with CL^2 and both describe lift-dependent drag at Mach>1. RCAIDE applies them additively.
highest_risk_pairs.required_evidence: A wing-only drag decomposition with a cross-check against an independent method (VSPAERO or SU2 Euler) at Mach 2.02; if the sum exceeds the independent total by approximately the smaller term, the pair is double counted.

highest_risk_pairs.reason: Compression effects are partly inside the parasite compressibility factor and partly in the separate compressibility term.
Until D-BODY-4 exists, it is unknown whether any body/interference drag is already embedded inside the volume wave-drag or fuselage parasite terms.
highest_risk_pairs.required_evidence: Explicit correction model with calibration data.

double_counting_assessment.reference_area_rule: RCAIDE converts internally to coefficients on Sref = 358.25 m2. VSPAERO and SU2 will each expose their own Sref/cref/bref conventions; every comparison must be done in N with the force direction stated, and any CD comparison must state the reference area used.
double_counting_assessment.unit_rule: Force ledger in N first; q_inf = 0.5*rho*V^2 at 18288 m and Mach 2.02; rho and speed of sound must be recorded from the mission atmosphere state, not assumed.

consequences: Body parasite drag scales with wetted area: +10.62% versus the upstream declared value, a real shift in D_BODY-1.
Volume wave drag scales with frontal/maximum cross-sectional area: a -36.89% difference in the declared frontal area is a large relative change in D-BODY-2.
Because the two upstream-vs-computed deltas have opposite signs, the net body-drag change is not predictable from the deltas alone; it must be computed once the correction model exists.
No drag term can be labelled a 'body correction' until the fixed fuselage source is frozen (baseline_reference_decision.md is still a proposal) and the correction model is defined.
fixed_fuselage_impact.decision_required: Owner must freeze the fixed-fuselage source (owner already selected computed values on 2026-10-30) and the resulting correction/decomposition must be independently reviewed before any D_total claim.

required_before_any_sum: Export every component as a signed N force in body axes from one evaluation.
Verify the sum of components equals total_drag*Sref*q_inf within numerical tolerance.
Run one independent wing-only method (VSPAERO thin-surface or SU2 Euler) at Mach 2.02 and compare total lift and drag in N.
Resolve D-LS-1 vs D-LS-2 overlap with either a documented RCAIDE internal statement plus independent comparison, or a re-parameterised model.
Define and calibrate D-BODY-4, or explicitly report it as NOT_VALIDATED and exclude it from any pass claim.
non_actions: no claim that the current RCAIDE drag build-up is physically correct at Mach 2.02
no VSPAERO or SU2 results fabricated
